'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''ROPS'''. Username '''HARPSTER'''. L39 Darth Vader With Lightsaber (sheet w/ Stick); L40 Mara Jade With Lightsaber.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' HARPSTER
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
